plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Spanish for Health Professions Concentration (BA) program page (poid=946), which is printed as a standalone program. Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The introduction states a minimum of 27 semester hours is required for the major, that all Spanish courses offered above SPAN 020 may count toward the major, and (in the printed NOTES) that at least three of the required Spanish courses, including at least one 200- or 300-level course, must be completed at Salem, with the same placement-waiver rule as the Spanish major. The introduction's first sentence prints the word 'progam' [sic]. The recorded total (27) is the exact printed minimum: the three Required courses and three Concentration Courses at 18, the Select One slot at 3, and two elective slots at 3 each under the printed Electives line ('Additional SPAN elective courses above SPAN 105 to reach a minimum of 27 semester hours'). Prerequisites recorded only where every named course is a fixed course in this plan: SPAN 206 requires SPAN 105; SPAN 207 requires SPAN 206; SPAN 208 requires SPAN 207; SPAN 211 requires SPAN 206. Disclosed, not recorded: SPAN 030's and SPAN 105's printed prerequisites each offer placement by the Program Director as an alternative to the named course (SPAN 020 is not a course in this plan).

courses.title: Health-Related Spanish Select One
courses.choice_note: Select one course (the topic or setting must be health- or health-care related and approved by the program director), as printed. Recorded at 3 Hour(s). All four printed options are variable-hour, so none is listed here as a fixed-credit option: SPAN 200 Independent Study Spanish (1-4 Hour(s)), SPAN 250 Special Topics in Spanish (1-4 Hour(s)), SPAN 270 Internship in Spanish (1-4 Hour(s)) and SPAN 290 Honors Independent Study Spanish (3-4 Hour(s)). A completion using one of them above 3 hours totals more than the recorded total, as printed.
